experiment: Reused-process, single-mode microbench → independent run cohorts, cold/warm and observer modes; all W
evidence_and_decision: Retain manifests, histogram/raw samples and load-generator delay. Reject comparisons with unmatched semantics, artifacts or unexplained noise.

experiment: Full helper invocation per mandatory check → inline allowance check with cold scheduler branch at identical boundaries; W02
evidence_and_decision: Cycles/operation, branch/code footprint, peer/kill tails. No admission bypass or removed required check. [37](research/37-checkpoint-and-continuation-costs.md)

experiment: Maximum fixed continuation/full state saves → generated live-state storage and selective helper updates; W01/W02
evidence_and_decision: Saved bytes, first-growth versus reuse latency, process density and code size. Reject untracked owned state or stale omitted fields. [37](research/37-checkpoint-and-continuation-costs.md)

experiment: Uniform small chunks → bounded cost-aware chunks for admitted copy, matching and fanout; W02/W04/W05
evidence_and_decision: Work per turn, actual uninterrupted segment and tails. Fail if a byte count or callback hides unbounded work; no quota semantics. [37](research/37-checkpoint-and-continuation-costs.md)

experiment: Generic admitted helper/matcher dispatch → generated scalar and typed-protocol fast paths; W02/W05
evidence_and_decision: Dispatch cost, branch misses and code size across many protocols. Slow paths must preserve order, control, errors and cleanup. [37](research/37-checkpoint-and-continuation-costs.md)

experiment: Full event trace → disabled, counters-only and sampled modes; W01–W07
evidence_and_decision: Observer overhead, event loss and snapshot consistency. Retain full ownership traces for correctness separately; sampling is not exhaustive evidence. [37](research/37-checkpoint-and-continuation-costs.md)

experiment: Clone/serialize admitted owned value → transfer its ownership into the mailbox; W03/W04
evidence_and_decision: Copies, allocations, send cost and discarded-payload cleanup. Qualify partial publication/death and cross-worker transfer; Rust type size or `Send` alone is insufficient. [34](research/34-message-allocation-and-copy-costs.md)

experiment: Separate envelope/payload allocations → inline small payload or combined allocation; W03/W04
evidence_and_decision: Allocation count, cache footprint, threshold discontinuities and failure injection. Large enum variants must not silently inflate every process/mailbox node. [34](research/34-message-allocation-and-copy-costs.md)

experiment: Generic self-send → process-local self-send path preserving required signal order; W03
evidence_and_decision: Lock/copy savings with tracing and control traffic. Reject overtaking the sender's earlier pending monitor/control signals or changing permitted selectable order; no new global order across unrelated senders. [34](research/34-message-allocation-and-copy-costs.md)

experiment: Copy bytes to every recipient → freeze once and share immutable runtime-owned storage; W04/W07
evidence_and_decision: First freeze separately from subsequent send, refcount traffic, final release and retained capacity. No mutable aliases or arbitrary destructor escape. [34](research/34-message-allocation-and-copy-costs.md)

experiment: Always retain shared backing for a byte view → copy small long-lived slices under an explicit internal policy; W04/W07
evidence_and_decision: Copy cost versus backing-capacity retention across view sizes/lifetimes. Shared bytes remain valid through publisher death; threshold is experimental. [34](research/34-message-allocation-and-copy-costs.md)

experiment: Direct locked ingress → measured adaptive buffered/batched ingress; W04/W08
evidence_and_decision: Contention, allocation, light-load latency and same-sender order. Require slot/array lifetime and first-arrival wakeup models; buffer retirement remains a prerequisite. [30](research/30-buffered-signal-publication-protocol.md), [34](research/34-message-allocation-and-copy-costs.md)

experiment: Unconditional trace metadata/copying → disabled fast path plus explicit trace slow path; W03/W04
evidence_and_decision: Cost with trace off/on, payload lifetime and observability. Enabled semantics cannot be lost to gain off-mode throughput. [34](research/34-message-allocation-and-copy-costs.md)

experiment: Correct full selective scan → freshness-proved saved-prefix marker; W05
evidence_and_decision: Messages inspected, fallback/recycling cost and match latency. Unknown IDs use full scan; test final priority-capability removal while accepted priority messages remain queued, including the prior debug assertion, before adoption. [28](research/28-selective-receive-marker-protocol.md), [29](research/29-pinned-reference-observations.md)

experiment: One simple correct deadline index → wheel/tree or hybrid chosen by measured deadline distribution; W06
evidence_and_decision: Insertion/removal, sparse idle scanning, bytes/timer and expiry delay. Distinguish allocator thresholds from placement thresholds; preserve clock/range/rounding semantics.

experiment: One time-tree node per timer → shared exact-deadline groups; W06
evidence_and_decision: Tree operations and clustered-expiry cost. Exercise singleton, representative replacement and cancellation during partial expiry; no global equal-deadline order invented.

experiment: Helper-local batch bound → scheduler-visible budget across all expiry continuations; W02/W06
evidence_and_decision: Count callbacks per outer wheel bump and time until a peer runs, including self-rearming at-once service callbacks. Test source-predicted repeated batches before claiming a bound.

experiment: One shared timer service → per-worker ownership and routed remote operations; W06/W08
evidence_and_decision: Local/remote fraction, queue hops, cancel response tails and migration cost. Preserve timer identity and read/cancel/expiry outcomes.

experiment: Individually notify/reclaim remote cancellations → bounded batches with explicit flush/progress conditions; W06/W07
evidence_and_decision: Atomic/wakeup cost and retention delay; logical cancellation and physical reclamation recorded separately. No indefinitely stranded small batch.

experiment: Allocate every timer uniformly → size/lifetime-informed local pools or reusable slots; W01/W06/W07
evidence_and_decision: Cold allocation, memory high-water mark, reuse and stale-ref tests. Distinguish preallocation policy from wheel routing; reclaim through shutdown.

experiment: Fixed charge per timer callback → payload-sensitive accounting and resumable runtime release; W02/W06/W07
evidence_and_decision: Callback duration, copied bytes and reference-release work for equal timer counts with different payload shapes. Reject unbounded hidden cleanup or improved expiry throughput achieved by unreported reclamation backlog.

experiment: Uniform balancing → locality-biased placement and migration only when skew warrants it; W04/W08
evidence_and_decision: Queue delay, migrations, cache misses and throughput; reject starvation or transfer of ineligible state. Placement does not change process identity.

experiment: Successful-steal count alone → budget total visited entries, retries and transfers; W08 with mostly bound entries
evidence_and_decision: Critical-section/scanning time, victim-lock contention and progress. A 100-transfer cap does not prove bounded work.

experiment: Single-item stealing → batch sizes varied by transferable work and measured contention; W08
evidence_and_decision: Lock amortization versus locality and tail delay; excluded/bound entries and priority classes remain accounted for.

experiment: Fixed active-worker set → adaptive compaction with hysteresis; W08 changing load
evidence_and_decision: Utilization, wake delay, migrations and oscillation. Source reduction history is a policy input, not a universally optimal load metric.

experiment: Immediate park or fixed spin → measured spin/park and wake coalescing variants; W08 sparse/bursty
evidence_and_decision: Idle CPU/energy where available, wake tail and throughput. Include long quiet periods and contention; retain lost-wakeup invariants.

experiment: Population-only balancing → per-priority and eligible-work-aware estimates; W08 mixed work
evidence_and_decision: False migration/steal attempts, lower-priority progress and control latency. Do not flatten supported scheduler priority or invent strict round robin.

experiment: Many unconditional queue statistics updates → cheaper sampled/per-worker summaries with exact ownership accounting; W08
evidence_and_decision: Cache-line contention and estimate error. Approximate policy statistics cannot become approximate execution ownership.

experiment: Uniform cleanup traversal → resumable ownership-aware chunks and dedicated runtime cleanup work; W07
evidence_and_decision: Kill-stop, DOWN visibility and full tracked cleanup separately; bound nested final-release work. Runtime progress must not depend on application receive or arbitrary user `Drop`.

experiment: General allocation of runtime records → per-worker slabs/free lists with bounded remote returns; W01/W04/W07
evidence_and_decision: Allocation hot spots, cache locality, fragmentation and post-churn retained memory. Audit slot generations, delayed readers, failure and shutdown before tuning. Full ERTS allocator internals remain future source work.

experiment: Current source trace of possible late buffer installation → controlled sender/exit pause experiment and ownership model
evidence_and_decision: Establish whether replacement installation is reachable and how it is reclaimed, with forced/debug and normal-contention paths separate. This is a correctness prerequisite for buffered designs, not a confirmed upstream bug or a speedup benchmark.

experiment: Independently selected microbench improvements → integrated room/session comparison with one change and then supported combinations; W01–W07
evidence_and_decision: Report operating ranges and interference, including slow consumers, churn and CPU hogs. Reject wins that vanish in the first-product workload; compare BEAM and async Rust only under stated equivalent semantics.

experiment: Cyclic victim selection → recent-success or topology-local search with bounded exploration and complete fallback; W08
evidence_and_decision: Unsuccessful probes, remote traffic and drain latency of distant hot queues. Keep topology and seeds; reject a locality preference that repeatedly misses eligible work. Topology awareness is a Bream hypothesis, not a finding about BEAM's index order. [35](research/35-scheduler-locality-and-load-balancing.md)

experiment: Protected mutable migration policy → immutable published plan snapshots if reads are a measured bottleneck; W08
evidence_and_decision: Reader/update cost and retired-plan retention with stalled readers. Prove protection before dereference and reclamation after readers, including shutdown; do not copy raw ERTS epoch assumptions. [35](research/35-scheduler-locality-and-load-balancing.md)

experiment: One shared-buffer reference operation per holder → modeled batched reference reservations during fanout; W04/W07
evidence_and_decision: Atomic contention versus reservation overhead for one buffer and many views. Register each recipient obligation before visibility; return unused reservations after partial fanout or kill without tying recipient lifetime to publisher. [34](research/34-message-allocation-and-copy-costs.md)

experiment: Linear adoption of received ownership metadata → bounded resumable adoption or direct ownership transfer; W03/W05/W07
evidence_and_decision: One large buffer versus many references of equal total bytes; measure receive cost and peer tails. Payload survives node removal, and partial adoption is kill-safe. Moving a long walk into dequeue is not constant-time receive. [34](research/34-message-allocation-and-copy-costs.md)

experiment: Equivalent small tagged/traced state representation → generated native typed owning fields; W01/W04
evidence_and_decision: Generic root visits, tag checks, bytes copied, frame/code size and cleanup tails. Mutable/cyclic data needs a declared policy; compiler types do not automatically make an arbitrary graph collectible.

experiment: Individually owned qualified allocations → process-private region/index storage; W01/W04/W07
evidence_and_decision: Allocation cost versus unreachable retained bytes over long process lifetimes. Test contained cycles, stale indexes, external immutable owners and partial construction; whole-region release requires proof that all escaped obligations are handled.

experiment: Stable boxed continuation → eligible owner-plus-offset generated state that can relocate; W01/W02
evidence_and_decision: Growth/shrink/move correctness, indirection, copying and density. Forbid byte-moving pinned fields or escaped borrows; force same-base and moved-base allocation outcomes. This is an alternative to qualify, not blanket permission to relocate native state.

experiment: Exact initialized-owner ledger with fine-grained reclamation → the same exact ledger with coarser retained batches in qualified helpers; W01/W04/W07
evidence_and_decision: Bookkeeping saved versus dead-but-retained bytes, partial-state cleanup and return/error/suspend behavior. Coarser retention must remain visible and cannot keep resources beyond the supported lifetime contract.

experiment: Periodic discovery of writable/frozen buffer descriptor state → consuming typed builder-to-frozen transition with immediate bookkeeping; W04/W07
evidence_and_decision: Removed ownership-list traversal, transition/refcount overhead and spare-capacity retention. Preserve sent snapshots; safe constructor/view/clone paths must not recover mutable access to published bytes.

experiment: Generic tagged addresses and boolean insertion result → typed protocol address plus ownership-bearing occupied/vacant result; W01/W03
evidence_and_decision: Compile-fail protocol/transition cases, collision allocation, dispatch branches and code size. Runtime namespace/incarnation checks remain mandatory; types do not certify that an address is still alive.

experiment: Flag-driven partially initialized spawn record → consuming staged construction and qualified preallocation; W01/W07
evidence_and_decision: Initialization/copy/allocation cost and recovery at every failure boundary. If identity is externally visible, preserve valid early operations. No application execution or uninitialized access before construction and initial relationships complete; exact skeleton-publication timing is not prescribed.

experiment: Individually boxed records with protected free IDs → stable chunked generational slots; W01/W08
evidence_and_decision: Churn, occupancy, page/cache cost, free-token retries and retired capacity. Include tiny model counters to force wrap; no storage moves under readers or silent stale-address aliasing.

experiment: Fully provisioned record → small header, separately typed body and lazy cold metadata; W01/W03/W07
evidence_and_decision: Idle density, send/kill lookup cost and first inspection/trace activation. Include failed publication and losing CAS cleanup; compare fairly with BEAM's already-lazy metadata.

experiment: Retain/release record on every lookup → scoped guard-bound internal borrow, explicit retention only for deferred work; W03/W08
evidence_and_decision: Atomic churn, service latency and retention under stalled/forgotten guards. Compile-fail escaped borrows and prove aliasing/reclamation; a public address must not keep application execution alive.

experiment: Generic allocation/free routing metadata → typed internal owners for qualified runtime allocation classes; W01/W04
evidence_and_decision: Routing checks, allocation frequency, layout/padding and compiler code size. Audit partial initialization and correct allocation-family return; payload type is not sufficient if carrier ownership can change.

experiment: Direct current-owner remote frees → explicit bounded return batches with owner revalidation/redirection; W04/W07/W08
evidence_and_decision: Queue CAS/lock cost, cross-worker traffic, redirection count and final-small-batch progress. Caller, original allocator and current carrier owner may differ; model managed and unmanaged participants separately.

experiment: One conservative retirement phase → separately justified payload-reuse and metadata-retirement phases; W01/W07/W08
evidence_and_decision: Retired bytes and allocation reuse rate with paused readers. Accept earlier reuse only where metadata remains valid and readers cannot access reused payload; do not turn one epoch check into universal reuse permission.

experiment: Fixed local/fixed-size/carrier retention → measured cache trim and empty-carrier policies; W01/W07/W08
evidence_and_decision: Cold-start versus warm allocation, burst recovery, high-water retention and shutdown completion. Report allocator caches separately from live ownership; no unbounded trim work on a process turn.

experiment: Nominal element-count memory estimates → actual layout/allocation-capacity accounting by runtime ownership class; W01/W04/W07
evidence_and_decision: Compare logical bytes, unique backing, padding, reserved slabs, retired metadata and RSS. First validate target atomic/slot sizes; do not infer an exact physical total from a helper's approximate accounting formula.

experiment: Destructor-dependent admitted handle cleanup with all bypasses rejected → independently tracked cleanup obligations for supported handles; W01/W07
evidence_and_decision: Test forget, ManuallyDrop, partial transfer and dead receivers before measuring registration/removal cost. No premature free of escaped/live-recipient state. This compares two contracts to enforce the same accepted cleanup behavior, not permission to leak.

experiment: Conservative borrow-free generated body → admitted local borrows retained in compiler-generated pinned state; W01/W02
evidence_and_decision: Consumer acceptance/rejection, resume/kill validity, frame size and indirection. The existing language probe is a control; automatic boundary coverage, one execution owner and bounded cleanup still need actual Bream fixtures.

experiment: Public generic marker/constructor sketch → closed generated representation and qualified helper boundary tested from another crate
evidence_and_decision: Reject forged admission and hidden operations through traits, callbacks, globals, aliases and construction helpers. Keep useful typed positive examples. Record diagnostic usability, build/code-size cost and supported surface; no production-performance claim until the boundary is established.

experiment: Generic readiness envelope construction → compact typed notification with owned registration identity; W09
evidence_and_decision: Allocations, copied bytes, dispatch cost and code size. Preserve replacement/cancel/detach ownership and existing no-new-interest syscall elision; never recycle a published envelope.

gates_and_dependencies: I/O gate then G7; IO-01.C17/19, EXEC-03/07
experiment: Dense FD-indexed state with growth under striped locks → stable chunked registration slots and qualified generation keys; W09
evidence_and_decision: Sparse-descriptor memory, growth pauses and lookup cost. Test copied events, duplicates, wrap and validation-to-use races; a generation match alone does not retain the descriptor.

experiment: Correct immediate one-shot rearm → coalesced interest changes with explicit publication/acknowledgment rules; W09
evidence_and_decision: Control syscalls, ready-to-service delay and cancel-to-close tails. Preserve independent directions, recipient replacement, sticky error-interest history and failed-operation poststate; reject lost wakes or hidden close delays.

gates_and_dependencies: G7 and I/O gate; IO-01.C23, EXEC-07
experiment: Dedicated poll workers → qualified scheduler-local read polling; W08/W09
evidence_and_decision: Wakeups, cache cost, throughput and unrelated peer delay. Include changing recipients, migration back, full tracking slots and shutdown; public one-shot notifications do not imply every backend pollset is one-shot.

experiment: Process an adaptively growing result batch → explicitly bounded dispatch slices retaining the unfinished batch; W02/W07/W09
evidence_and_decision: Poll overhead versus cold-FD delay, kill responsiveness and retained bytes. No discarded events, starved late entries or abandoned batch on worker/runtime shutdown.

gates_and_dependencies: I/O gate then G7; IO-01.C24, EXEC-05/07
experiment: Coalesced wake pipe → qualified alternative notification primitive; W08/W09
evidence_and_decision: Wake syscalls/CPU, producer contention and idle wake tails. Force full/empty transitions and interruption; preserve no-lost-wakeup protocol, absolute deadline handling and internal-event filtering.

experiment: Correct compact deleted-incarnation records with individual allocation → typed chunked storage and owned snapshot cursor; W10
evidence_and_decision: Allocation/cache cost, retained history and snapshot latency under churn. BEAM already avoids retaining complete process bodies here; preserve insertion/deletion interval and incarnation identity.

experiment: Abandoned snapshot frees eligible history while holding table write lock → bounded unlink/detach plus resumable reclamation; W01/W07/W10
evidence_and_decision: Table-lock hold time, peer spawn/send delay and cleanup backlog. Preserve other enumeration markers and active readers; detached storage must retain a cleanup owner through kill/shutdown.

experiment: Charge selected record actions → account all traversed continuation work, including markers and session/ref lookup; W02/W10
evidence_and_decision: Maximum observed uninterrupted segment and total observation throughput. Preserve cursor progress and snapshot/cleaner semantics; numerical source work counts are not time bounds.

experiment: Repeated per-session tracee lookup → single-pass attachment classification or compact typed index with distinct public-handle and cleanup ownership; W01/W10
evidence_and_decision: Destroy/clear cost versus attach/detach overhead, retention and event load. Loss of all public and temporary owning holds must still trigger destruction; tracee/index membership cannot itself keep the session enabled.

experiment: Generic queued diagnostic payloads → compact typed records with explicit in-flight observer retention; W03/W07/W10
evidence_and_decision: Event allocation/copy and formatting cost, code size and teardown backlog. Preserve accepted-event disposal, ordering, sensitivity and replaced-observer lifetime; deferred formatting must use qualified data.

experiment: Dynamic resource/reference decoding → typed association and fixed-layout monitor record; W10
evidence_and_decision: Register/cancel/claim cost, lookup/cache and allocation. Types may reject wrong kinds; runtime provenance, generation, origin claim and both endpoint lifetimes still require validation.

experiment: Allocate tree node for every resource monitor → inline first relation with qualified overflow storage; W10
evidence_and_decision: Common single-relation cost versus promotion, many-target churn and cleanup. Preserve independent repeated monitors and exact ownership through overflow allocation failure; no silent deduplication.

experiment: Repeated shared holds/general stop job → move a qualified stop capability into runtime cleanup; W07/W09/W10
evidence_and_decision: Atomic operations, queue hops, stop latency and retained storage. Retain shared holds whenever uses overlap; no close before backend/callback access ends or reliance on application Drop.

experiment: Generic callback with temporary term environment → typed runtime lifecycle event and statically selected qualified handler; W10
evidence_and_decision: Temporary bytes, event/dispatch cost and generated code size. Preserve supported notifications and nested-work accounting; this qualified boundary does not claim arbitrary callback compatibility.

experiment: Unsliced monitor/resource-ledger teardown → runtime cleanup cursor and separately accounted final-release work; W02/W07/W10
evidence_and_decision: Peer progress, cleanup throughput and retained bytes after all user execution stops. Every step must be qualified; arbitrary user destructors cannot hide inside the final step. Static code may omit takeover bookkeeping only under an explicit static-resource boundary.

experiment: Confirm progress at every qualified runtime turn → fewer confirmations only at explicitly eligible boundaries; W02/W07/W12
evidence_and_decision: Barrier/cache traffic versus retirement age and retained bytes. Never announce quiescence while protected access survives; preserve sleep/block/code-barrier rules and measure stalled-worker interference.

experiment: Complete remaining participant scan in one coordinator update → proved resumable scan allowance; W08/W12
evidence_and_decision: Scan/lock time, progress advancement, wakeups and peer tails across worker counts. Preserve confirmation/election state across slices; no starvation of late scan entries or inactive-as-quiescent shortcut.

experiment: One correct reclamation domain → separately qualified domains for unrelated metadata with typed or validated identity; W07/W12
evidence_and_decision: Retention caused by one stalled reader versus extra metadata and cross-domain handoff. Cross-reachable objects need all applicable protection or an explicit retained owner; no unsafe shutdown or memory hidden in a different account.

experiment: Backlog-scaled eligible callback count → bounded cleanup cursor accounting for nested releases; W02/W07/W12
evidence_and_decision: Uninterrupted work, peer delay, drain throughput and retained backlog. Preserve detach-before-callback, owned continuation and qualified final release. Specializes PERF-029 for progress-eligible work; it does not permit arbitrary user callbacks.

experiment: Correct byte-threshold cleanup wake coalescing → qualified byte-plus-age or idle-flush policy; W07/W12
evidence_and_decision: Wake CPU, final-small-batch age and peak retired memory. Establish the baseline route through eligibility and execution first; no premature free, lost wake or cleanup depending on further application traffic.

experiment: Dynamic lock masks/field conventions → private typed field-access guards and checked rank transitions; W01/W03/W12
evidence_and_decision: Removed redundant checks, code size and access/kill latency. Compile-fail escaped/stale borrows; dynamic PID order and whole lock graph still need proof. Internal guards must not escape into indefinitely running host/application code.

experiment: Packed lock/control word → qualified separation of contended domains or a simpler combined lock in the same supported concurrency profile; W03/W08/W12
evidence_and_decision: CAS retries, cache-line traffic, memory per process and tail latency. Preserve lock-set semantics and terminal-state coordination; fewer bits or atomics is not itself an improvement.

experiment: Fixed configured spin-before-park → measured contention-aware spin/park policy; W02/W08/W12
evidence_and_decision: CPU burn, park/wake count, lock wait and unrelated process delay. Count CAS-only retries and partial-set holding time; no total wait bound inferred from a resettable spin counter or per-domain FIFO.

experiment: Manually maintained acquired masks/rollback branches → owned partial-set acquisition and handoff records; W12
evidence_and_decision: Failure/contended-path branches and ownership bookkeeping, plus retained state during wait. Force failure at every acquisition position and all supported backends; cannot unlock an unowned domain, duplicate same-process authority or rely on application Drop.

experiment: Every process embeds contention queue metadata → optional cold waiter record or compact indexed representation; W01/W12
evidence_and_decision: Idle density/cache cost versus first-contention allocation and wake tails. Retain metadata through granted-but-not-resumed waiters; no unqualified allocation under runtime locks or retirement while a handoff can access it.

experiment: Dynamically tagged domain/unit values → private typed instants, deadlines and durations with checked constructors; W06/W11
evidence_and_decision: Tag/check branches, instructions, layout and compile-fail misuse controls. Runtime origin identity and overflow remain explicit; inspect generated code before calling a wrapper zero-cost.

experiment: General checked wide time conversion → constant-unit specialization with verified fast path and wide fallback; W11
evidence_and_decision: Divisions, cycles, code size, fallback and rejected-boundary rates. Preserve operation-specific ceiling and signed floor; no blanket Duration truncation, overflow wrap or zero-timeout allocation change.

experiment: Correct service clock sampling → per-batch observation with mandatory fresh registration and wait-boundary reads; W06/W11
evidence_and_decision: Clock calls, actual kernel crossings, cycles and expiry/peer tails after long batches. Compare with an already cached baseline; stale service may add measured lateness but cannot backdate a newly registered relative deadline.

experiment: Repeated generic wait conversion → typed retained absolute deadline with specialized remaining-wait conversion; W09/W11
evidence_and_decision: Conversion/read cost, wakeups, retry CPU and timeout/stop tails. Keep the original deadline across capped or empty waits; backend precision changes must preserve the supported public resolution.

experiment: Required correction under an RW lock → immutable versioned correction snapshot or initialization specialization for a qualified corrected provider; W11/W12
evidence_and_decision: Read contention, update cost, retries and retired snapshots. Compare first with the existing direct-provider path; preserve continuity, reader retention and configured failure behavior. No lock-removal win against a baseline that never took that lock.

experiment: Generic boxed operation/argument/result tags → private typed request variants and compact correlation handles; W14
evidence_and_decision: Allocations, copied bytes, record size, branch/code footprint and admission throughput. Preserve signal ordering and accepted/rejected ownership; reject type-confused or lost replies.

experiment: Existing per-turn work deduplication → explicit pending-work state plus separately owned request records for additional qualified coalescing; W14
evidence_and_decision: Expensive operations per request, queue memory, reply latency and mixed-priority tails. Reject lost correlation, false completion or starvation. BEAM already coalesces some GC work.

gates_and_dependencies: Qualified completion path; EXEC-08.C28, EXEC-03, LIFE-05
experiment: Monolithic reply drain → owned resumable completion cursor with budgeted admitted helpers; W02/W07/W14
evidence_and_decision: Uninterrupted work, lock time, throughput, peer latency and cleanup backlog. Reject replayed replies, orphaned remainder, early reclamation completion or unbounded inner copy work.

experiment: Scan-to-merge nonempty owned fragment chains → maintained-tail segmented ownership consumed at a private result gate; W07/W14
evidence_and_decision: Merge cost by segment count, metadata/cache cost and cleanup tails. Preserve all owners after death and suppress dead continuations. Empty-destination baseline already avoids traversal; external jobs remain unselected.

experiment: Generic priority routing in minimal profile → compile-time normal-priority specialization with independent control activity; W02/W14
evidence_and_decision: Queue/state bytes, dispatch cost and binary size against optimized baseline. Reject lost control/exit progress; full priority extension must retain its separate semantics.

experiment: General approved buffer handle for constant bytes → generated permanent-static/owned/shared variants; W03/W04/W07
evidence_and_decision: Allocation/refcount savings versus dispatch/code growth. Static bytes must be genuinely permanent and immutable; reject hidden leaked allocations, unaccounted dynamic owners or unsupported constant replacement.

experiment: Correct arena retirement enumerating admitted roots → generated typed holders plus runtime owner records to avoid unrelated scans; W10/W14
evidence_and_decision: Visited owners, scan/copy work, index contention and stop/cleanup tails. Reject missing diagnostic/helper/message holders, registration after publication or strong-count snapshots treated as reclamation proof.

experiment: One retained immutable region per live view → per-payload ownership or measured small-survivor copy-out; W04/W07/W14
evidence_and_decision: Retained capacity versus allocation/refcount/cache costs, sparse and dense views. Preserve owner-plus-offset validity and final release; reject moving memory into unreported global retention. Extends PERF-010 with constant-region ownership.

gates_and_dependencies: Conditional replaceable data graphs; CODE-01.C07–09, LANG-03
experiment: Qualified whole-region scratch/relocation → generated non-destructive layout visits or index graphs with external forwarding state; W14
evidence_and_decision: Copied bytes, temporary memory, sharing/edge visits and dense-case tails. Retain source plus partial destination across kill/yield; reject lost sharing, early publication or unbounded traversal. No requirement to implement a GC.

experiment: String-key and already-interned integer baselines → compact owned runtime-specific name tokens; W13
evidence_and_decision: Hash/allocation cost, cardinality, retained tokens and cleanup tails. Include interning expense; BEAM already uses atom identity. Reject stale-name reuse or cross-runtime aliasing.

experiment: Checked erased binding per lookup → concrete typed address after explicit resolve-once; W13
evidence_and_decision: Type-check/dispatch cost and code size at identical resolution semantics. Reject covariance bypass and stale protocol authorization. Dynamic named sends/timers still check the selected binding; mismatch policy is open.

experiment: Single correct registry lock → name shards plus coordinated target registration ownership; W13
evidence_and_decision: Contention, retries, writer/kill tails and record retention. Reject two names for one target, two owners for one name, lock-order cycles or stale backpointers. One-key insertion does not cover both constraints.

experiment: Protected owned-name copy → compact token vector with qualified allocation/version strategy; W10/W13
evidence_and_decision: Writer blocking, allocation, copied bytes and peer latency across registry sizes. Preserve result lifetime and the declared snapshot consistency; reject escaped borrowed entries or silently weaker per-shard snapshots.

experiment: Correct typed resolution per operation → version-validated cache with safe record retention; W06/W13
evidence_and_decision: Hit rate, invalidation traffic, retained records and rebind/expiry tails. Model check/use races; reject sticky first-owner behavior, incompatible payload delivery or indefinite retention. Cached PID is a distinct workload.
